Represent every training transition occurrence as (sₖ,dₖ), including repeated pairs. Within each dataset, keep the source array fixed and randomly permute the destination array, then rebuild counts Cπᵢⱼ. This preserves every source and destination occurrence count exactly while destroying pair association; shuffling unique edges or globally relabeling items does not provide this control. Under unrestricted permutation, E[Cπᵢⱼ]=rᵢcⱼ/N, the fixed-margin independence expectation ([SciPy documentation](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy-1.11.2/reference/generated/scipy.stats.random_table.html)). Use multiple recorded seeds, identical scoring and evaluation settings, and report the observed-minus-null metric with the null spread. Preserve category routing; allow self-transitions unless a constrained null is explicitly intended.

Smoothing must match between observed and permuted tables. Applying standard additive smoothing, Pα(j|i)=(Cᵢⱼ+α)/(rᵢ+αM), yields the derived expectation E[Pπα(j|i)]=(rᵢcⱼ/N+α)/(rᵢ+αM). Thus its residual against destination popularity cⱼ/N is generally nonzero: smoothing pulls toward uniformity, especially for rare sources. Log transforms, clipping and ranking introduce additional nonlinear effects, so calculate the null through the complete scoring pipeline instead of assuming zero residual ([Jurafsky and Martin](https://web.stanford.edu/~jurafsky/slpdraft/ed3book.pdf)).

For diagnostics on counted training occurrences, leave out the evaluated occurrence: decrement Cᵢⱼ, rᵢ, cⱼ and N by one, recompute affected priors and normalization, and retain other occurrences of that pair. For a matched null, permute the remaining destination occurrences after exclusion. This applies transition-level cross-validation ([methodological example](https://ppw-okpiv.pages.gitlab.kuleuven.be/research/AutoRegressions.jl/dev/CrossValidation/)). Compare inclusive and excluded diagnostics, particularly singleton pairs. Gains disappearing after exclusion indicate self-count influence; surviving gains still require held-out validation because overlapping histories remain dependent.
